messages.subject: Discrepancy in Results Between Previous and Current Analyses
parts:
Hello,
I initially analysed the data several months ago and have recently repeated the analysis using the same dataset and models. However, I noticed notable discrepancies between the two analyses in terms of the model fit indices and parameter estimates, despite the sample size and degrees of freedom remaining identical. I was wondering whether these differences in the results could be attributable to the different versions of the `lavaan` package used for the analyses.

Thank you!
Best,
A
